recent.text: Jaylen Brown: “I felt good. I felt fine. I felt athletic.” Says the two early fouls made it hard for him to find a rhythm. Asked about Jayson Tatum trying to greet him pregame, he said he is just trying to focus on helping his team win. “Credit to Jayson. Credit to the Celtics.”
